name: main asks for the token before the free checks (a missing build is hidden by the token message)
the token's name is hard-coded, so the tool entry's account_env is ignored
a firmware folder with no main.py runs (the board boots to a bare prompt)
a wokwi.toml firmware line this cannot read is accepted, and the run writes one image while wokwi-cli simulates another
an indented, unreadable firmware line is not seen
the wall clock has no startup allowance, so wokwi-cli is killed while it connects
a run that outlives its wall clock leaves no log
a killed wokwi-cli's bytes are joined as they are and crash the log
find: return output.decode("utf-8", "replace") if isinstance(output, bytes) else (output or "")

name: a wokwi-cli that cannot start crashes the run instead of reading as could-not-run
